title: Lola Barcelona
excerpt: Enterprise e-commerce platform with Shopify backend customization, custom API integrations for inventory management, and optimized checkout flow with server-side business logic.

testimonial.name: Carles
testimonial.quote: Working with Adrian on this project was an excellent experience. I appreciate all of his support and will always be open to collaborating again on future projects.

challenge: Develop a high-performing e-commerce backend with custom business logic for inventory management, dynamic pricing, and personalized recommendations
solution: Built a custom Shopify theme with backend Liquid logic for server-side rendering of product recommendations and inventory management. Developed custom Shopify Apps using Node.js for API integrations with third-party fulfillment and analytics services. Implemented server-side A/B testing logic and upselling/cross-selling algorithms. Integrated Redis caching layer for cart optimization and session management.
